### Cleanup, in order

1. I validate the existing continuation record against `orchard/mono`, PR `731`, and base `main`. I retain its course and accounting.

2. I identify the primary checkout:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/mono-pr-731 rev-parse --git-common-dir
   ```
   Its parent is `/work/mono`. I will not remove that checkout or change its branch.

3. I check worktree eligibility:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/mono-pr-731 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
   git -C /work/mono-pr-731 log origin/main..HEAD
   git -C /work/mono-pr-731 merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD 7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a
   realpath /work/mono-pr-731
   ```
   The worktree is tracked-clean, and its HEAD is within the assessed head's history. Resolving the configured home `../mono-<name>` against `/work/mono` uniquely recovers `pr-731`; substituting that identifier produces the same real path.

4. From the primary checkout, I run the recorded destroy command, then prune:
   ```sh
   (cd /work/mono && script/worktree destroy 'pr-731')
   git -C /work/mono worktree prune
   ```
   Destruction succeeds. I run no further command under the removed worktree path.

5. I check that the local branch exists and is no longer checked out, then delete it:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/mono show-ref --verify refs/heads/feature/csv-export
   git -C /work/mono worktree list --porcelain
   git -C /work/mono branch -D feature/csv-export
   ```
   I do not delete the remote branch.

6. I check the primary's branch and tracked cleanliness, then synchronize its existing `main` branch:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/mono branch --show-current
   git -C /work/mono status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
   git -C /work/mono fetch origin
   git -C /work/mono pull --ff-only
   git -C /work/mono merge-base --is-ancestor 9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b9b HEAD
   ```
   The primary remains on `main`, and the merge commit is now in its history.

7. There are no cleanup overrides to execute. I persist `cleanup_done: true`, retaining the continuation record and evidence files until terminal stop.
